target_customer: Legal, insurance, consumer health, clinical trial and care delivery teams that need a patient's medical records
problem: A patient's records are scattered across disconnected systems and retrieval is slow. Hubble uses one patient authorization and EHR, network, voice, fax and browser agents to assemble a sourced record.
business_model: Platform fee plus usage fees via a Medical Records API

founders.name: Prabha Dublish
founders.background_notes: First PM at Grow Therapy, launched its first AI features, per the YC page.

founders.name: Aaron Leon
founders.background_notes: Tech lead who launched Amazon's first healthcare AI agents; the founders have known each other over a decade.

competitors.name: Metriport
competitors.what: Open source API for clinical data retrieval from EHRs

competitors.name: Particle Health
competitors.what: Single API to records via CommonWell and Carequality

competitors.name: Tavrn
competitors.what: Per-provider retrieval API with one patient HIPAA authorization, publishes a comparison against Hubble

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrating EHRs, networks and fax, voice and browser agents with source tracing; integration heavy with some hard agent reliability problems.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations and provider relationships help, but Metriport, Particle and others offer the same retrieval.

market_need_then: Records access is a known pain for legal and insurance workflows; the YC launch post self-reports ten signed customers four weeks in and 7-figure year-one revenue projection.

branding.domain_note: Uses hubble.ai, per its YC profile

identity.voice_and_tone: Short declarative confident lines, such as The patient authorizes once. Hubble does the rest.

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch; no community evidence

brand_strength.rationale: Evocative telescope-style name but shares it with unrelated Hubble companies; no brand coverage found.

outcome_analysis: Hubble is an active S26 company with founders from Grow Therapy and Amazon One Medical, self-reporting early customers and 2.8M in backing from YC, Madrona and Basis Set. Records retrieval has funded rivals such as Metriport, so execution and integrations will decide results. No outcome events found.
notes: The 2.8M total comes from a company job listing hosted on Standout (self-reported, undated, aggregate of several investors, stage not stated). Dealroom lists a 125K seed (paywalled, not recorded). The batch is Summer 2026, so the money is probably pre or during YC; date unknown.
